facts.fact: Cenfri reports that NISR staff built a machine-learning model that predicts ISIC, ISCO and ISCED codes from Kinyarwanda, English or French descriptions, and that it is now used by analysts and monitors, with 96 percent of records auto-coded correctly in one test run.

systems.platform: machine learning model trained on NISR coded survey data since 2017; Android app for enumerators exists
systems.owner: National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda (NISR)
